preConditions.onFailMessage: RSDEV-1735: files saved through the Egnyte file store were not repointed, because the database does not have exactly one local FileStoreRoot that is current. Retrying on the next startup.

and.sqlCheck: select count(*) from FileProperty where external = 1
select count(*) from FileStoreRoot where external = 1 and current = 1
select count(*) from FileStoreRoot where external = 0
select count(*) from FileStoreRoot where external = 0 and current = 1

changeSet.comment: Point files saved through the Egnyte file store back at the local file store root, and retire the Egnyte FileStoreRoot (the row is kept, no longer current, as a record of where the files were in Egnyte). Their local copy was never deleted (InternalFileStoreImpl.removeFile does nothing), and relPath is the path under both roots. The upload overwrote each file's original local root_id, so the repoint is only safe when the database has exactly one local root, and it is current. In any other state that still has Egnyte rows, the precondition skips this change set without recording it, so it is retried on every startup until an administrator fixes the roots.
